title: Hashfuncs
subtitle: Fast fingerprints, buckets & cache keys.
intro: Hash SQL values with named non-cryptographic algorithms. Choose a stable representation and seed for repeatable partitioning, probabilistic-filter inputs and compact fingerprints.

reference.name: xxh3_128_hex(text [, seed])
reference.description: Canonical 32-character lowercase hex digest for strings and BLOBs.

reference.name: xxh32 / xxh64
reference.description: Classic xxHash variants, with optional seed overloads.

reference.name: murmurhash3_32 / murmurhash3_x64_128
reference.description: Named MurmurHash3 variants for explicit algorithm selection.

notes.title: Keep the representation fixed
notes.body: Match input bytes, type and seed. Fixed v1.5 hex output uses canonical high64 then low64. Older 0dec806 reverses those halves. Numeric UHUGEINT output retains its legacy layout for stored-key compatibility; use the hex function for interchange.

notes.title: Collisions are possible
notes.body: Hashes are compact fingerprints, not uniqueness constraints. Retain original keys for exact equality. Use crypto for authentication or adversarial inputs.

examples.title: Route to 16 buckets
examples.sql:
SELECT i, xxh3_64(i, 42) % 16 AS bucket
FROM range(8) AS t(i);
examples.caption: The same input type and seed assign each value to the same bucket.

examples.title: Format a string fingerprint
examples.sql:
SELECT xxh3_128_hex('hello') AS digest;
-- 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters
examples.caption: Fixed v1.5 builds match canonical xxHash digests directly.

examples.title: Choose the output width
examples.caption: Choose the width for your collision budget and storage format.

assertions: SELECT CASE WHEN xxh3_128_hex('hello')='b5e9c1ad071b3e7fc779cfaa5e523818' AND typeof(xxh3_64('hello'))='UBIGINT' AND typeof(xxh3_128('hello'))='UHUGEINT' THEN true ELSE error('Hashfuncs canonical digest or width mismatch; requires fixed v1.5 build') END;
